description: Two independent exciters, each blending its input with a saturated copy of it

params.text: Sets the balance in that half, 0 passing the input untouched and 1 passing the saturated copy alone

inputs.text: The signal saturated in that half
Each volt here adds 0.1 to the wet and dry balance of that half, added to its MIX knob and clamped to 0 and 1

outputs.text: The input of that half and its saturated copy blended as its MIX knob sets
